claim_limit: Confirmatory stability of maintained-archive aggregate long-short returns only. It does not establish independent replication, non-micro tradability, point-in-time ticker selection, prospective performance, or capital readiness.
forbidden: No candidate additions after outcome inspection
No threshold changes after outcome inspection
No replacement of missing SmileSlope observations after January 2023
No live decision weight from this study
purpose: Falsify the three conservatively adjudicated 10bp archive-supported candidates using stability, concentration, resampling, and negative controls without fitting weights or thresholds to outcomes.
required_gates: global-corrected factor-controlled 10bp alpha lower bound positive in validation and lockbox
at least 70 percent of rolling 36-month raw excess means positive in each split
at least 60 percent of calendar-year raw excess means positive in each split
at least 80 percent of leave-one-year-out raw excess means positive in each split
no single positive calendar year contributes more than 50 percent of total positive cumulative excess within either split
moving-block bootstrap probability of positive 10bp excess mean at least 97.5 percent in each split
reverse-sign candidate fails the primary alpha gate in both splits
